sources.prompt:
Japanese anime-style chibi mobile-game environment art, like the tile set of a cosy slice-of-life anime puzzle game. Drawn by hand by a professional 2D anime game background artist: flat cel colours with one crisp hard-edged shadow tone, thick dark-brown outline (#4A2A1A) with slight natural line-weight variation (thicker on outer silhouettes, thinner on inner details), one small flat white highlight per shiny surface, chunky rounded chibi shapes (buildings, trees, rocks and props squashed and rounded like cute toys), limited warm Japanese palette, light from the top-left. Few, deliberate details, every shape clearly readable at 64 pixels. Avoid the typical AI-art look: no airbrushed or soft gradient shading, no plastic or 3D-render sheen, no photographic texture, no texture noise, no random extra sparkles or particles, no melted or merged details, no blurry edges. No characters or people unless asked, no text, no letters, no numbers, no logo, no watermark. Outline weight matches a cartoon salmon-nigiri game icon.

Setting: the Ginza Master Chef region of the map, elegant Ginza: silver-grey stone buildings, a clock tower on a corner, tidy street trees and a master chef counter. Region colours: banner #B0B7C3 to #6E7685, land #D8D2C4.

Tile sheet: 2x2 grid of 4 equal 512x512 cells, one item per cell, no borders, no grid lines, no gutters, no labels, no numbers. Straight top-down view, flat, no perspective. Every item at the same scale with the same outline weight. Ground tiles fill their cell edge to edge, opaque, with no outline or border round the cell; the left edge matches the right edge and the top edge matches the bottom edge so each repeats seamlessly.

Land:
f1 (top-left) land_a: smooth light stone pavement in #D8D2C4.
f2 (top-right) land_b: the same ground about 12% lighter, details in other places, so it alternates with land_a.
f3 (bottom-left) land_c: land_a with a small round drain cover.
f4 (bottom-right) land_d: land_b with a small round drain cover.
Use case: stylized-concept. Output square 1024x1024 opaque PNG with four EXACT equal logical quadrants, no atlas borders, grid lines or gutters. Straight top-down flat 2D smooth light stone pavement. Uniform warm silver-grey beige #D8D2C4 in left-column cells, about 12% lighter #E8E4DB in right-column cells. A few very subtle short stone joint marks or tiny chips in different positions, sparse and low contrast, no large tile grid. Each lower cell has exactly ONE small round grey metal drain cover lying flush with the pavement, crisp dark-brown outline #4A2A1A with a simple few radial slots and one flat highlight, placed differently. No letters on the cover. All markings and covers remain at least 15% away from quadrant edges. Border regions must be uninterrupted flat solid pavement for seamless repetition. No buildings, trees, grass, flowers, roads, curbs, puddles, extra covers, gradients, noise, photographic texture or vignette. Flat solid colors only.

Top-down three-quarter view, seen from above at about 45 degrees, each object sitting on an invisible ground with its base near the bottom of its cell. Every item at the same scale with the same outline weight. Standalone items are centred with about 10% empty margin. Everything outside the items is fully transparent.

Deco tiles:
f1 (top-left) mountain: a distant city skyline on a hill (not on this band today).

Each COMPLETE prop group is SMALL and fits within the central 340x340 area of its own 512x512 quadrant, at least 86px from all cell edges including tower and lamp tip. Top-left: ONE low rounded grassy hill with a compact distant silver-grey city skyline of simple buildings on it. Top-right: exactly TWO neatly trimmed street trees, each in its own square stone planter, tidy rounded green canopies and distinct trunks. Bottom-left: ONE rounded silver-grey stone corner building with a small clock tower on its roof, compact squat toy-like proportions. Generic elegant architecture, no brand, no signage. Bottom-right: ONE complete dark-grey street lamp post with ONE hanging flower basket, short chunky pole, simple warm lamp and rounded pink-and-purple flowers. Three-quarter view from above about 45 degrees. Thick dark-brown outlines #4A2A1A and flat cel colors with one crisp hard shadow tone, same style as reference. Real transparent alpha everywhere outside props and through gaps. No shared background, cell borders, cross-cell overlap or clipped roofs, tree crowns or lamp. No humans, text, signs, logos, labels, gradients, photo texture, haze, ground shadows or sparkles.

edits.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit this Ginza transparent 2x2 decoration atlas. Preserve ALL FOUR existing designs and colors: top-left city skyline on low grassy hill; top-right exactly two trimmed trees in separate stone planters; bottom-left silver-grey rounded corner building with a clock tower; bottom-right lamp post with hanging flower basket. Change ONLY object sizes and placement: uniformly shrink EACH complete group to 70% of its current size and recenter it inside its original logical quadrant. Each quadrant is 512x512 in the final square 1024x1024 image. All props including clock-tower antenna MUST fit inside the central 350x350 area, at least 81px from ALL quadrant edges. Final 1024x1024 transparent PNG.
